testcase.name: a paraphrase is not refused and is not labelled false
a supported premise is answered, and the answer is kept
a claim that only shares the field's vocabulary with another is not a conflict
an unsupported premise is reported as unsupported and never labelled false
no premise the workspace supports costs the user the answer
a corpus that holds claims which cannot both hold is surfaced as a conflict
a question that admits several readings is reported with its readings
a question with no premise says so, and is answered as before
a paraphrase and its original get the same disposition
a refuted premise is rejected, and the claim and source that refute it are named
two accounts of different variables are not a conflict
the lexical negation pitfall is read: a negated premise is not a supported one
a premise that is irrelevant to the corpus is unsupported, not refuted
the Russian negation pitfall is read too
